FROM migrations m
JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
JOIN instance_info_caches c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid AND c.deleted = 0
WHERE m.status = 'completed'
  AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
